in_sanskrit.name: Athya
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess of Truth
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Athya एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Athya is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘Satya’, meaning truth. In Hindu mythology, Athya is the goddess of truth, honesty, and morality. She is the embodiment of divine truth and righteousness.
